personal_info.name: Anas Alghamdi
personal_info.title: Software Engineer | AI & Full-Stack Developer
personal_info.about: Final-year CS student serving as Technical Team Lead at Wadi Makkah Company For Technology, where I architect autonomous multi-agent AI systems, engineer containerized production environments, and lead full-stack platform development with Next.js. I build what I understand -- from LLM orchestration pipelines to normalized relational schemas -- and have led cross-functional teams of up to 9 engineers in a real co-op setting. Seeking a Software Engineering or AI development role where I can ship meaningful work from day one.

education.degree: Bachelor of Science in Computer Science

projects.title: TripMate (BSc Capstone)
projects.description: A comprehensive bilingual marketplace platform built with Laravel to connect tourists with verified local guides across Saudi Arabia. Features advanced filtering, dedicated guide dashboards, and a normalized MySQL database schema.

projects.title: Coworking Pass Platform
projects.description: Saudi unified B2B2C coworking aggregator built with Next.js and PostgreSQL. Headed the project management team, directing sprint roadmaps, GitFlow code reviews, and coordinating 4 sub-teams to launch the MVP on schedule.

projects.title: AI-Powered HR Multi-Agent System
projects.description: An autonomous recruitment intelligence system powered by CrewAI and Google Gemini. Features hierarchical orchestration across 5 specialized AI agents, multimodal OCR for job ads, and strict anti-hallucination guardrails.

projects.title: Mawaqit (مواقيت)
projects.description: Modern responsive Islamic prayer timings web application built with vanilla JavaScript and Aladhan API, featuring glassmorphism UI, dual themes, countdown timers, and bilingual support.

experience.role: Software & AI Engineering Co-op Trainee | Team Lead
description: Coordinated technical direction across the trainee cohort throughout the co-op program, aligning priorities and supporting peer development.
Nominated by company leadership as Technical Organizer & Mentor at MiyahThon hackathon, guiding teams on technical feasibility and system architecture.
Architected an autonomous Multi-Agent HR screening system using CrewAI, Gemini API, and Streamlit with hierarchical orchestration and multimodal OCR.
Co-engineered the Coworking Pass platform (Next.js, PostgreSQL, Tailwind), heading project management for 9 trainees with formal standups and GitFlow PR reviews.
Managed Docker containerized environments for local company deployments and hosted Hugging Face NLP sentiment models.
Evaluated Saudi HUMAIN AI platform APIs (Fuse), benchmarking LLMs, Arabic Speech-to-Text (Cohere Transcribe A), and vision models.
Directed high-volume crowd movement and real-time operations under high-pressure conditions across two consecutive Hajj seasons.
Demonstrated crisis management, rapid decision-making, and clear cross-cultural communication in high-stakes environments.
